.]] The Prey system is a feature in in which players can hunt down a specific target. Upon selecting a target, they can be found through various means throughout the different Midnight zones, and defeating them will earn rewards. Prey targets can be chosen by interacting with the Hunt Table for a specific target or by speaking to Astalor for a random or custom hunt (if unlocked). There are three available difficulties: Normal, Hard, and Nightmare. While other players can aid in the hunt on Normal, on Hard and Nightmare the target must be fought solo and will have a number of affixes to increase the difficulty of the fight. While on prey hunts one will collect the Remnant of Anguish currency

Preying For Midnight is a meta prey achievement earned by completing the listed achievements part of the Prey system. It rewards the title.
Prey: Insane Inventors (Hard) is a prey achievement earned by defeating Senior Tinker Ozwold or L-N-0R the Recycler in a prey hunt on hard mode. It rewards the Preyseeker's Tinker Bust decor.
Prey: Mad Magisters (Hard) is a prey achievement earned by defeating Magister Sunbreaker or Magistrix Emberlash in a prey hunt on hard mode. It rewards the Preyseeker's Magister Bust decor.
Prey: No Rest for the Wretched (Hard) is a prey achievement earned by defeating Lost Theldrin or Neydra the Starving in a prey hunt on hard mode. It rewards the Preyseeker's Wretched Bust decor.
Prey: Outsmarting the Schemers (Hard) is a prey achievement earned by defeating Praetor Singularis or Consul Nebulor in a prey hunt on hard mode. It rewards the Preyseeker's Consul Bust decor.
Prey: Sadistic Shamans (Hard) is a prey achievement earned by defeating The Talon of Jan'alai or The Wing of Akil'zon in a prey hunt on hard mode. It rewards the Preyseeker's Amani Bust decor.
Prey: The Fallen Farstriders (Hard) is a prey achievement earned by defeating Ranger Swiftglade or Lieutenant Blazewing in a prey hunt on hard mode. It rewards the Preyseeker's Farstrider Bust decor.
